name: hunger-free-erp
description: Hunger Free ERP - Unified Development Environment

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "frontend,backend" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "cd backend && .\venv\Scripts\python manage.py runserver"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && cd backend && .\venv\Scripts\pip install -r requirements.txt
